title: Organic Gardening
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Agriculture; not yet checked by a CBC Agriculture teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Grow a short-season crop (kale, beans or dhania) with only organic inputs: compost, a Tithonia (Mexican sunflower) foliar feed, an ash or chilli spray, and hand weeding. Keep a record of each input.

skills.key_step: The child explains organic practices: compost and manure, organic pesticides, mechanical weeding, foliar feeds from animal waste and plants like Mexican sunflower, crop rotation, mulching, and why they give healthy food and soil.

floor.prerequisite: Knows how pests are controlled without chemicals.
floor.question: Name a control without chemicals.

steps: Feed the soil: compost and manure.

board.do: Write "organic gardening = no inputs at all?".
List compost, foliar feed, organic spray.

listen_for: Growing with no inputs or care at all
misconceptions.repair: Compare an organic bed (compost, care) with an untended one.

misconceptions.ask: Can an organic garden give a good harvest?
misconceptions.repair: Show the class organic bed at harvest.

misconceptions.ask: Why do people choose organic food?
misconceptions.repair: Read a pesticide label's waiting period before harvest.

misconceptions.ask: Why is crop rotation used in organic gardening?
misconceptions.repair: Recall Grade 8: rotation stops soil pests building up.

checks.question: Name two organic gardening practices.
checks.answer: any two of compost, organic sprays, hand weeding, foliar feed, rotation

skills.key_step: The child says how organic inputs are prepared and used: compost dug in; a foliar feed of Mexican sunflower or manure soaked two weeks, then diluted; an organic spray of chilli, garlic, ash or neem; sprayed when cool; hand weeding.

floor.question: What is a foliar feed?
floor.answer: a liquid feed sprayed on leaves

steps: Chop and soak leaves or manure for two weeks.
Spray or water in the cool of the day.

board.do: Write "sun breaks the spray and burns leaves".

misconceptions.ask: How is Mexican sunflower liquid feed used?
misconceptions.repair: Compare leaves sprayed with strong and diluted feed.

misconceptions.ask: How long is a plant or manure liquid feed left to soak?
misconceptions.repair: Compare the colour of a one-day and a two-week soak.

misconceptions.ask: When is the best time to spray an organic pesticide?
misconceptions.repair: Explain sun breaks down the spray and burns wet leaves.

listen_for: Fresh manure straight from the shed
misconceptions.ask: What kind of manure is used on an organic garden?
misconceptions.repair: Show seedlings scorched by fresh manure.

checks.question: Why is a liquid feed diluted?
Name a plant used for an organic foliar feed.
